DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL connection URL. Auto-wired from the sibling 'postgres' service via companion variable references.

REDIS_URL.description: Redis connection URL. Auto-wired from the sibling 'redis' service over Railway's project-isolated private network (no password needed).

BUZZ_S3_ENDPOINT.description: S3 endpoint for media storage. Points to the sibling 'minio' service on its S3 API port (8080).

BUZZ_S3_ACCESS_KEY.description: S3 access key. Auto-wired from the sibling 'minio' service.

BUZZ_S3_SECRET_KEY.description: S3 secret key. Auto-wired from the sibling 'minio' service.

BUZZ_S3_BUCKET.description: S3 bucket name for media storage.

RELAY_OWNER_PUBKEY.description: Optional: Nostr public key (hex) that owns this relay. If empty, the relay runs in open mode.

BUZZ_RELAY_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Nostr private key (hex) for the relay. Auto-generated per deploy.

BUZZ_GIT_HOOK_HMAC_SECRET.description: HMAC secret for git hook verification. Auto-generated per deploy.

BUZZ_AUTO_MIGRATE.description: Run database migrations automatically on startup.

BUZZ_GIT_CONFORMANCE_PROBE.description: Run the git conformance probe on startup. Disabled by default because it requires the S3 bucket to already exist; the bucket is auto-created on first media use.
